svg.title: Two independent paths to the vault key
svg.desc: A Master Password-derived KEK or the random Recovery Key unwraps the same DEK from its own config slot. The DEK authenticates and decrypts the stored vault. TOTP is an application sign-in gate, not an input to either key path.
